variant.description: The build this image is, as a release's update set names it, for example Heltec_v3_companion_radio_standalone. Absent on v0.2.0 and earlier.

upstream.description: The MeshCore release it is built on, for example v1.18.0.

device_id_sig.description: The device id signed with the node key (AUTHORITY.md). Absent where the build cannot sign it.

nonce.description: The caller's nonce, echoed when the request carried one.

device_id_sig_nonce.description: The device id and the caller's nonce, signed with the node key. Present only with nonce.

channel_nonce.description: This link's channel nonce, for the sensitive and private-stream requests that must carry it (AUTHORITY.md).

next.description: Present only when the capability list continues: send hello again with this as args.cursor. A hello that fits in one page, which is nearly every one, has no next.

update.description: Present only while the image of an update job runs unconfirmed: that job, and the version and SHA-256 of the running image (UPDATES.md section 7, step 3), with unconfirmed:true when its job is already over.

sha256.description: null on the nRF52, whose bootloader installs a package the device cannot hash: the version is the attestation (UPDATES.md section 6).

unconfirmed.description: The job ended without a confirmation, yet this image runs: the image before it failed its trial each time it was sent back (UPDATES.md section 7, step 6).
